relationships.subject: CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: One month after administration of CGRP-mAb formulations in patients with MOH at our hospital, MHD was significantly improved.

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The MHD change rate was 40%, indicating significant improvement (p=0.0034)

key_findings: In 34 MOH patients, monthly headache days fell from 22 to 16.9 one month after CGRP-mAb; galcanezumab improvement was significant, erenumab was not.
Patients who switched to another CGRP-mAb improved significantly less than non-switchers.
